boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Salve Regina traditions centered on its Mercy heritage, class milestones, and seasonal gatherings.

cards.title: Mercy Week
cards.subtitle: Fall campus observance
cards.notes: Look for the large MERCY lawn display and attend a listed reflection, discussion, reading, lecture, or service activity during the fall observance.
cards.short_summary: A fall week that turns Salve’s Mercy roots into campus reflection, celebration, and action.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve states that Mercy Week occurs each fall and is marked by reflection, celebration, and action.
cards.access_notes: Programming varies by year; consult Salve event listings for current details.

cards.title: McAuley Day
cards.subtitle: Mercy Week finale on McAuley Lawn
cards.notes: Find the current McAuley Day schedule during Mercy Week; documented celebrations have included food, games, service, and community-building.
cards.short_summary: Salve’s annual celebration honoring Catherine McAuley and the Sisters of Mercy legacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve calls McAuley Day a beloved tradition and describes it as the conclusion of Mercy Week.
cards.access_notes: Event activities and locations can change annually.

cards.title: Celebrate Catherine McAuley’s Birthday
cards.subtitle: McAuley Day observance
cards.notes: Watch for the annual birthday gathering on McAuley Lawn, a concrete way Salve connects its campus calendar to its Mercy founder.
cards.short_summary: A birthday observance for the woman whose legacy underpins Salve’s Mercy mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve documents an annual Catherine McAuley birthday celebration on McAuley Lawn as part of McAuley Day.
cards.access_notes: Held as part of McAuley Day; confirm the current program before visiting.

cards.title: Receive the Mercy Medal
cards.subtitle: Class Convocation milestone
cards.notes: New students should keep the mercy medal presented at Convocation and bring it back for Commencement, following Salve’s documented class custom.
cards.short_summary: A small medal links the beginning of a Salve class’s journey to its graduation ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve says it bestows mercy medals to each class at Convocation and that students wear them at Commencement.
cards.access_notes: For Salve students; contact Mission Integration if a medal was not received.

cards.entity_name: Wearing the Mercy Medal at Commencement
cards.title: Wear the Mercy Medal Across the Stage
cards.subtitle: Undergraduate Commencement custom
cards.notes: Graduating students can wear the mercy medal received at Convocation when crossing the Commencement stage; retain it with graduation items.
cards.short_summary: The class medal returns at graduation as a visible thread through a student’s Salve experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s Commencement guidance instructs graduates not to forget the mercy medal bestowed at Convocation.
cards.access_notes: Applies to graduating Salve students at the official Commencement ceremony.

cards.title: Festival of Lights at Ochre Court
cards.subtitle: Annual interfaith light observance
cards.notes: Attend the Festival of Lights in Ochre Court’s Great Hall for student music, dance, readings, and reflections drawn from multiple faith traditions.
cards.short_summary: An annual Salve gathering that uses shared light rituals to reflect on peace and many faiths.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve describes the Festival of Lights as an annual tradition dating to 2001 and held at Ochre Court.
cards.access_notes: The cited event was free, open to the public, and required no registration; verify current event details.

cards.title: Find the Luminaria Around the Chapel
cards.subtitle: Our Lady of Mercy Chapel and McAuley Circle
cards.notes: Walk the lantern display around Our Lady of Mercy Chapel and McAuley Circle during the holiday observance, and read the tribute dedications respectfully.
cards.short_summary: Paper lanterns illuminate Salve’s chapel area in tribute to loved ones.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve calls the Luminaria a cherished tradition that began in 2020 and coincides with the Christmas tree lighting.
cards.access_notes: Lantern dedications have involved a contribution to The SALVEfund; viewing access may vary by event.

cards.title: Volunteer as a Luminaria Light Finder
cards.subtitle: Holiday lantern service project
cards.notes: Ask the Luminaria organizers about helping assemble and place lanterns, or serving as a light finder with the tribute directory during the event.
cards.short_summary: A student service role supports visitors locating lantern tributes during Salve’s Luminaria.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve documents student volunteers who position Luminaria lanterns and serve as light finders with flashlights and a directory.
cards.access_notes: Volunteer opportunities and sponsoring groups may change; contact the current event organizer.

cards.title: Count Down to the Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: McAuley Hall Circle
cards.notes: Join the campus gathering for caroling and the tree-lighting countdown at McAuley Hall Circle; use the event listing for the current date and time.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Salve gathering built around music, a blessing, and lighting the campus tree.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve describes its Christmas tree lighting as an annual event and tradition that brings the community together.
cards.access_notes: A 2025 university event listing placed this gathering at McAuley Hall Circle; verify the current listing.

cards.title: One Day. One Salve.
cards.subtitle: Annual campus giving day
cards.notes: Follow the annual Day of Giving updates to see current campus activities and designated funds; participation is optional and donation-based.
cards.short_summary: A yearly Salve community fundraising tradition supporting students and university programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve identifies its Day of Giving as an annual tradition that brings the campus community together to support students.
cards.access_notes: Giving is optional; current activities and donation options are announced by the University.
